0x0008B0.en: 「I'm not strong enough yet...@　This is as far as I go...!」

0x0009A9.en: 「Dammit! You won't get me next time!」

0x000A23.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000BD3.en: 「Ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000C0E.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　Not funny...」

0x000C62.en: 「Blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000D4C.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000DB3.en: 「This is it for me... the rest is up to you.」

0x000E21.en: 「Nngh! Did they get the better of me...」

0x000E5F.en: 「No good, took too much damage... Retreating!」

0x000EAC.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000EEA.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000F31.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000FDC.en: 「Gah...! To think I'd become a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x00105B.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go...!」

0x001093.en: 「Owowow... I give. That was a miscalculation.」

0x001185.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0011CC.en: 「I'm sorry. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x001201.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my strength...!?」

0x0012ED.en: 「To go down in a place like this...@ I'm still green...!」

0x00133B.en: 「No good, this is my limit! Retreating!」

0x0013B4.en: 「Sorry!@ I'm gonna have to pull out...!」

0x0013F6.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x001425.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001463.en: 「Well, well. So this is where it ends.」

0x001492.en: 「I can't go on. I'll be taking my leave.」

0x001741.en: 「Guhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001953.en: 「No good, they went and got me.」

0x001A42.en: 「...There were some twists and turns,@ but at last I've set foot in this fortress.@ In a sense, it's rather moving.」

0x001B00.en: 「Naturally you wouldn't know, being a mercenary@ dispatched from Golieskuln, but...」

0x001B6B.en: 「Originally, this was a plant I had those apes...@ the <EOT Special Council>, prepare for me,@ as proof of loyalty to Zovorg.」

0x001C3A.en: 「Once this is settled, we resume the Earth@ invasion. This time the apes won't see it@ coming. We'll wipe out several nests for good.」

0x001CFE.en: 「Yes... I'd been thinking ahead, but@ those cocky apes need a harsh whip.@ So no one like that man ever appears again.」

0x001DB2.en: 「Before something this important,@ isn't it dangerous for you to answer his invitation yourself?@ It's surely a trap.」

0x001E3F.en: 「That's exactly why I'm bringing you@ and Chafrois along as my escorts.@ ...I won't leave anything to chance.」

0x001EC6.en: 「...Zeb and I told the Commander the same thing,@ but he wouldn't listen. If anything, it was like@ his eyes lit up, y'know?」

0x001F74.en: 「Is there a reason worth taking such risks@ to go out there...」

0x001FD0.en: 「Seems that way.@ Well, marching out at your side isn't so bad.@ Don't tell me you'd rather not?」

0x00205D.en: 「...As a mercenary, I only follow orders.」

0x0020AD.en: 「It's... different from before.@ From those days I spent with you... it's different.」

0x002167.en: 「Is this Zezernan person really coming?@ It's about that time.」

0x0021CF.en: 「He'll come.@ I scattered plenty of bait he'd find tempting.」

0x00224D.en: 「The Gaia Sabers, the Masou Kishin, the Steel Dragon Squadron...@ and I myself am the bait to reel him in.」

0x0022CA.en: 「Ah, so then...@ the reason you had me contact Yang Long and the others...」

0x002326.en: 「That's right, to get them to come here.@ All four Masou Kishin.」

0x002382.en: 「Why does that make good bait?@ I don't get it.」

0x0023DB.en: 「I hear the Guests' supreme commander, Lord Zezernan,@ is the hands-on type.」

0x002440.en: 「When specialized forces gather in one place,@ he'll surely come out himself to observe them firsthand...@ That's how he'll think.」

0x0024D0.en: 「On top of that, I sent him a certain something.@ Once he sees it, he won't be able to stay calm.」

0x002587.en: 「Heh heh heh...@ It wouldn't be any fun if I told you now.@ Look forward to it.」

0x002615.en: 「So if this Zezernan guy shows up like you planned,@ what do you intend to do?」

0x002680.en: 「Don't tell me@ you actually just want to meet him?」

0x0026E9.en: 「Zezernan's a concern too, but@ I wonder if that Alteur fellow from the Gaia Sabers@ will show up as well.」

0x002770.en: 「You've never met him, have you, Master?」

0x0027BC.en: 「No. It'll likely be our first meeting.」

0x0027EA.en: 「Likely?@ Have you met him or not?@ Which is it?」

0x00284D.en: 「That... I'd like to know myself. Heh heh heh.」

0x00288A.en: 「I have no idea what he's on about.@ Master's always talking in riddles like this,@ throwing up a smokescreen...」

0x002944.en: 「Sounds meaningful but turns out to be nothing,@ or he just says vaguely clever-sounding things.」

0x0029D3.en: 「You think it's foreshadowing and listen seriously,@ then it's a total waste of time.」

0x002A66.en: 「Alteur Steinbeck... was it?@ He seems quite formidable on the surface world,@ but will he take the bait?」

0x002B14.en: 「He will. He seems fond of theatrical politics...@ if anything, he'll use this situation.」

0x002B9D.en: 「And that gives us an opening to exploit?」

0x002BCE.en: 「Yes.@ It's better to let the Steel Dragon Squadron@ move more freely... I'll lend a hand.」

0x002C64.en: 「I'll help you, in all sorts of ways.§」

0x002CD1.en: 「Yes.@ Sampling through Shu's Granzon,@ then accessing the network...」

0x002D8C.en: 「Then, shall we put on a little play...@ one greater than that Antarctic incident.」

0x002E38.en: 「Even so, we can't afford to let our guard down against that man.@ I wish the Commander wouldn't play it cool@ and ride out in something like a Liege.」

0x002ECB.en: 「Honestly, he ought to think about those of us protecting him.」

0x002F42.en: 「...Chafrois, Lacrein.@ You're forbidden from intercepting my comms with Shu Shirakawa. Understood?」

0x002FD2.en: (What...?@ Is there something they don't want us to hear?)

0x003022.en: 「It's been a while, Lord Teniquette Zezernan.@ Not since Antarctica. As I recall,@ you were Chief Secretary back then.」

0x0030DC.en: 「Hmph. Thanks to your rebellion@ the talks fell apart... and I went to great lengths@ just to escape that place.」

0x003175.en: 「And it cost me time and money@ to make my way back to the Earth Sphere. All your fault.」

0x0031EC.en: 「But thanks to that,@ Wendro, who I imagine was a thorn in your side,@ is gone. Am I wrong?」

0x003288.en: 「He was just a small fry that the Privy Council's opposition@ sent in to exploit a gap in my plan.@ Losing to the apes was only fitting.」

0x003331.en: 「By the way, Lord Zezernan...@ as I stated beforehand,@ please refrain from combat here.」

0x0033C1.en: 「You think you're in a position to order me?」

0x003401.en: 「If we cross swords, it'll trouble the other@ guests I've invited here.」

0x003475.en: 「What...?@ There are others coming here besides us?」

0x0034C5.en: 「Yes.@ If it comes to a fight, the information you seek@ won't be within your grasp, will it?」

0x00357E.en: 「Well, well... quite the guests before us.」

0x0035F1.en: 「A trap after all!@ Forward main guns, EAAM launchers, ready to fire!」

0x00367D.en: 「Let's play along with Shu Shirakawa's little diversion.@ As it is, the Guest forces aren't making a move.」

0x0036FD.en: 「B-but, Dr. Shirakawa said nothing@ about the Guests...」

0x003750.en: 「All forces, stand by until I give the word. Understood?」

0x0037B3.en: 「Commander, incoming transmission from@ Dr. Shu Shirakawa of the Granzon.」

0x003809.en: 「...I'll take it in the captain's quarters.@ Use the SSS line. No monitoring or recording.@ Let them know the same.」

0x00389A.en: 「Captain, I'll leave things to you here.」

0x0038BF.en: 「......What, you're not going to attack?　How dull.」

0x003902.en: 「Lord Alteur has his reasons.@　Stay silent and stand by.」

0x003961.en: 「Heh, it's an order from Omega Saber himself,@　our leader. I'll do as I'm told.」

0x0039C3.en: 「......Can you hear me, Dr. Shirakawa?@ This is Alteur Steinbeck,@ commander of the Gaia Sabers.」

0x003A4D.en: 「Commander Alteur......@　thank you for coming all this way.」

0x003AA0.en: 「What is the meaning of this?@　No one told me a Guest would be here.」

0x003B08.en: 「And yet, you gave no order to attack.@　Which means my offer intrigued you......@　am I wrong?」

0x003BC9.en: 「First, there's someone I'd like you to meet - allow me to introduce the Guest army's supreme commander, Lord Teniquette Zezernan.」

0x003C8D.en: 「Lord Zezernan,@ aboard that ship is Commander Alteur@ Steinbeck of the Gaia Sabers.」

0x003D26.en: 「Since before the <DC War>, Lord Zezernan has@　conducted secret talks with Earth, scheming to@　conclude an unequal treaty.」

0x003DC1.en: 「And Commander Alteur is the man plotting to seize@　control of the Earth Sphere by 'assassinating' the late president.」

0x003E56.en: （So that's it.@　I won't fall for that, Shu Shirakawa.）

0x003EAF.en: 「It was the Steel Dragon Squadron that killed the@　president. Enough of your worthless slander.」

0x003F23.en: 「Is that truly so?@　Some say the plot was yours, after all.」

0x003F9A.en: 「A baseless, vulgar rumor.@　Or do you have some kind of proof?」

0x003FFC.en: 「No.@　It's only that I've worked alongside the@　Steel Dragon Squadron myself......」

0x004068.en: 「It just struck me as odd that they'd assassinate@　the president. It fits far better to think@　the deed was yours.」

0x00412C.en: 「The apes' schemes are of no concern to me.@　Shu Shirakawa, what is the real reason@　you summoned us here?」

0x0041B9.en: 「The Earth Sphere is now under threat from Ruina and Baral.@ The black veil that covered Earth the other day......it could happen again.」

0x00427F.en: 「For each of you to achieve your aims, the Earth and@　those who dwell on it are indispensable......」

0x004305.en: 「So how about it?@　Why not have Earth and the Guests@　sign a temporary ceasefire?」

0x00437D.en: 「And if you cooperate, you might just be able@　to drive back the Ruina and the Baral.」

0x0043FB.en: 「Absurd. We are on the verge of taking the Moon.@　Unless the apes surrender, a ceasefire is out of the question.」

0x00447E.en: 「We are the Gaia Sabers, protectors of the Earth@ Sphere. Joining hands with aliens is unthinkable.」

0x0044F8.en: （No, wait......@　is staging this very meeting that man's true aim?）

0x00455D.en: （But the Guests should be his enemies too......@　what does he gain by ensnaring us?）

0x00477C.en: (Hmph......Shu Shirakawa. He means to use us@ to bring down the Gaia Sabers)

0x0047F3.en: （Very well, I'll play along with his little act.）

0x004855.en: 「Then what of the recon craft that appeared just@　before President Grusman died?」

0x00493E.en: 「Just as you say......it's a false charge, heh heh.」

0x004A0B.en: 「And Commander Alteur......@　that is precisely the secret about the Guests@　I mentioned to you the other day.」

0x004A9B.en: （......I have my suspicions,@　but I'll need to see it with my own eyes.）

0x004C65.en: 「That component is completely black-boxed. Investigating@　its interior is impossible......especially for Earth's apes.」

0x004E96.en: 「Even if you apes understood the Empire's technology,@　unraveling that would take......」

0x004F07.en: 「It didn't take much time at all.」

0x004F41.en: 「Hah, don't be absurd.@　As if Earth's apes could ever understand that.」

0x004FA3.en: 「My, what a stubborn man. Well, no matter.@　More importantly, it seems another set@　of guests I invited has arrived.」

0x005045.en: 「We made it, Shu!　Right on time!」

0x005082.en: 「You didn't get lost this time, Masaki.」

0x0050EC.en: 「He rushed off ahead, sure, but then got lost......@　ran into some weird monster on the way, nya......」

0x005172.en: 「And after all that, we finally made it here, nya.」

0x0051AF.en: 「Sh-shut it!　All's well that ends well!」

0x0051EF.en: 「I see......so that's why it's only you.」

0x0052A3.en: 「Masaki, you got here first!@　I was worried you'd wandered off@　and gotten lost somewhere......」

0x00535B.en: 「You don't have to explain every little thing!」

0x005395.en: 「Wow, we really came out into space.@　Masaki told me, but I guess Elemental Lords@　really can move in space too.」

0x005438.en: 「By the way, Master, what's that down there......」

0x005472.en: 「Yes, the Earth was blue......@　or rather, a soft, gently glowing pale blue.」

0x005508.en: 「You're the one who called us out here.@　And not just the Granzon, there's a ground army too.@　What's going on?」

0x0055A7.en: 「Who knows?@　I only did as Lord Shu commanded.」

0x0055F1.en: 「What in the world is that army......?」

0x00561C.en: 「I gathered intel beforehand, so I know.@ That side's the aliens called the Guests,@ the other's the Gaia Sabers.」

0x0056B8.en: 「Gaia Saber?@ The greatest operation in the Hero Chronicles, huh.」

0x005715.en: 「Master, there's a stranger mixed in with us~」

0x005783.en: 「That talk's for later, later.@　Looks like they're busy anyway.」

0x0057C7.en: 「Welcome, everyone.@　First, allow me to make introductions.」

0x005820.en: 「That is Commander Alteur Steinbeck@ of the Gaia Sabers......」

0x0058ED.en: 「Ho, so that is an Elemental Lord.@　This energy reading......indeed, Earth's military@　technology does seem superior.」

0x0059C3.en: 「Hmph......seeing it with my own eyes deepens my understanding.@　No wonder the Empire has set its sights on Earth.」

0x005B06.en: 「Take my advice: drop your weapons and surrender now.@ You're nothing but apes with high-tech weapons. You cannot beat our army.」

0x005C25.en: 「Zezernan, was it?@　Your predecessor said the same kind of thing,@　and he lost to us!」

0x005CB2.en: 「Don't lump me with a small fry like Wendolo.@ Unlike him, we don't scrounge locally - our army runs on our own nation's weapons.」

0x005D5A.en: 「Big words, from someone we beat in the opening battle.」

0x005D94.en: 「Watch your tongue, Alteur.@　I could erase a lunar city or two@　just to make an example, you know.」

0x005E5F.en: 「Very well. For barbarians like you,@　a show of force is best. Learn the extent of our power.」

0x005F5A.en: 「Yeah.@ If we sink the Gaia Sabers' flagship here,@ we'll spare ourselves pointless battles later.」

0x005FD5.en: 「So it's come to this after all.@　Well, I did expect as much.」

0x006031.en: 「Before the battle begins,@ let me show you something worth seeing.@ Especially you, Lord Zezernan.」

0x0060CB.en: 「What're you doing all of a sudden, Shu!@　You wanna throw down with us!?」

0x00612D.en: 「Quick to jump to conclusions as ever.@　That just now was no attack.」

0x0061E8.en: 「I-impossible......!@ That can't be...... Earth apes grasping that principle!」

0x00632C.en: 「In any case,@　your trump card is now nullified.@　Things will only go worse for you from here.」

0x0063C5.en: 「What's more, that mechanism is a forbidden move@　in your own nation, is it not?　That's precisely why@　you tried to handle it all in secret.」

0x0064E7.en: 「Hmph......do you think I would report@　things as they are to my homeland?」

0x006592.en: 「What in the world are you all talking about?　I don't get it at all!」

0x0065DE.en: 「Then let me explain. The Granzon uses not only@　<EOT> brought back from <Meteor 3>,@　but Guest technology as well.」

0x0066D3.en: 「To gain the initiative after the Aerogaters horned in,@　Lord Zezernan handed the Earthlings a 'lure'」

0x00678A.en: 「And to analyze it and prove it could be put to@　effective use, the development of the Granzon@　was decided upon.」

0x00683C.en: 「If they couldn't prove their worth, they'd be treated worse once conquered.@ Simply put, they wagged their tails at their would-be masters.」

0x00692D.en: 「Before the <DC War>......a handful who feared the <Aerogaters> put their own survival first and sought a way to live through it.」

0x0069EE.en: 「And that was when a pipeline to the Guests opened up.」

0x006A31.en: 「For their part, the Guests feared their own plans@　being obstructed by the Aerogaters......@　so it may have been a godsend for them.」

0x006AFA.en: 「And so......that handful of people sought the@　protection of the Guests, who unlike the@　Aerogaters could be negotiated with.」

0x006B8D.en: 「In other words, by accepting Zezernan's terms and effectively surrendering, they sought to ensure Earth Sphere and humanity's survival.」

0x006C4D.en: 「Hold on, that story......I've heard it before.@　So then, you're......」

0x006CAF.en: 「Yes, the <Antarctic Incident>......@　Lord Zezernan was present there as well.」

0x006D16.en: 「Putting on an elaborate act, appearing aboard@　an Aerogater warship......」

0x006D84.en: 「Was that to muddy your true identity?@　Or were you showing off your spoils?」

0x006E23.en: 「......Back to the topic: at the Granzon's core lies a singularity built with Guest tech......in other words, a black hole.」

0x006EE3.en: 「However, part of this system was black-boxed,@　and its details remained unknown.」

0x006F7C.en: 「The Guests took advantage of that to rig one device.@　It shifts the singularity's phase to create@　a naked singularity......」

0x007042.en: 「An ordinary singularity merely warps space-time.@ But given a certain phase, it can even alter@ events' probability density.」

0x007133.en: 「Uh, it means coincidences happen a lot, right?」

0x007173.en: 「Yes. As long as the Granzon exists, events that shouldn't happen keep occurring on Earth, and chaos reigns......that's how it was designed.」

0x007258.en: 「Haven't you found it strange until now?@　In this short span, Earth has suffered alien raids again and again......」

0x0072E7.en: 「And on top of that, the Einst, Shadow Mirror,@　Shura, and Ruina came from other worlds. Why did they@　all come to this world......」

0x0073A4.en: 「Are you saying that's all the Granzon's fault too!?」

0x0073EA.en: 「Let me be clear, this isn't something I wished for or engineered.@ Some incidents surely had no connection to the Granzon.」

0x0074A1.en: 「And the cause of the boundary with parallel worlds@　growing blurred may also lie within@　the Earth itself.」

0x007562.en: 「Even if I collapse the singularity, Earth won't@　escape this maelstrom of chaos.@　The die is already cast.」

0x00762C.en: 「In any case, tracing back human history, there has@　never been an age of such upheaval,@　and such chaos.」

0x0076BF.en: 「And the one who schemed to exploit that chaos and,@　if possible, monopolize Earth's military technology......@　is Lord Zezernan, there.」

0x007779.en: 「Absurd......I won't accept it!@　That lowly Earthlings could unravel that principle!」

0x0077E7.en: 「Even I couldn't find an energy with the properties@　needed to suppress the singularity,@　and it had me stumped.」

0x007877.en: 「But......a battle with a certain someone became@　the catalyst, and I gained a hint about that energy.」

0x007928.en: 「You have no need to know that.」

0x007990.en: 「I'm sorry for you, since you meant to use me and the@　Granzon......but that sort of thing@　is something I cannot allow.」

0x007A35.en: 「And so, I've laid it all bare@　here before everyone.」

0x007A94.en: 「Your hold on power won't@　last much longer now.」

0x007AE7.en: （......I'll pass this along to 'Grey' through Nibhal.@　That way, Zezernan will......）

0x007C24.en: 「This is footage being streamed on the net right now!」

0x007C8C.en: 「......Your coming here in person means I may take it@　you've accepted our offer, yes?」

0x007D03.en: 「A temporary ceasefire in exchange for handing over@　the Moon. A condition worth considering.」

0x007D74.en: 「Even if we could subjugate the satellite by our own@　power, I'd rather avoid the folly of needlessly wasting forces.」

0x007DF4.en: 「And a farce like the Antarctic Incident, as well.@　Despite showing us your submission,@　you people raised the banner of revolt.」

0x007E9F.en: 「The DC that led that rebellion has been purged.@　And soon I will gain the right to represent the Earth Sphere.」

0x007F41.en: 「I am seizing both authority and military power at once.@　Any who obstruct it, even a president, I remove.」

0x007FC7.en: 「No......I already have. By using the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x00800D.en: 「What is this!@　We're using the SSS line!@　How is it leaking to the outside!?」

0x008128.en: 「Oh, there's no need for that. The culprit is me.」

0x00816B.en: 「What!?　How did you get hold of something like this!」

0x0081A5.en: 「Magic and... a few other tricks.@　I got video and audio samples@　from Lord Shu's conversation.」

0x0082FB.en: 「Creeps? Weren't you creepy to begin with?」

0x00832C.en: 「Tch! Shoot that unit down@　and stop the transmission!」

0x0083C2.en: 「It's fine.@　A clumsy response would only backfire.」

0x008415.en: 「I'm aware it's a hackneyed trick.@　But the masses know that truth@　hides within falsehood.」

0x0084C0.en: 「You proved yourselves just how easily@　footage like that can be fabricated.@　Such a thing won't shake my power.」

0x00856E.en: 「Of course, I don't expect it to work instantly.@ But right now you're leading a unit,@ standing in the same place as Lord Zezernan...」

0x00862E.en: 「Not an alibi, but proof of presence at the scene.」

0x008674.en: 「I see. Your aim is to amplify suspicion of me.@　To spur my political rivals into action...」

0x00875F.en: 「An interesting man.@　Not my downfall, nor the Gaia Sabers',@　but restoring the Steel Dragons' honor.」

0x008848.en: 「Judging by the Gaia Sabers' rapid rise,@　there must be no small number in the Federation@　Congress and high command who resent you...」

0x008914.en: 「And suspicion breeds scandal.@　The more shocking it is,@　the more the world takes notice.」

0x008992.en: 「Then not only your rivals,@　but the fence-sitters will be swayed as well.」

0x008A31.en: 「But if the President's death was staged,@　as the Steel Dragons claimed...」

0x008AA5.en: 「If it comes out that you strong-armed things@　and buried the inquiry that should have happened...」

0x008B25.en: 「Those who backed the Gaia Sabers' founding@　could be undone. Then damage control begins,@　and it ties in with your political rivals.」

0x008BEB.en: 「Those who fear a rebellion like the old DC@　will want the Steel Dragons kept alive@　as a countering force.」

0x008C8A.en: 「I'm a man of the establishment. I've no need@　to rebel. And the Gaia Sabers are the sword@　that protects the Earth.」

0x008D22.en: 「A blade with rather a lot of suspicious tarnish, though.」

0x008D68.en: 「No wholly pure and upright organization exists.@　Show solid results, and the masses will follow,@　no matter what scandal is spread.」

0x008E3E.en: 「Hmph...@　Braving the risk to come all this way was worth it.」

0x008E94.en: 「I've learned not only Zezernan's scheme,@ but the cards in your own hand.」

0x008FCE.en: 「I'd rather not spend forces here.@　It'll cost us in the coming Ruina campaign.」

0x00902D.en: 「But to let this chance slip by!」

0x00BAF4.en: 「He won't actually check into a hospital, but...@　it's a state of emergency, with a counterattack@　against Ruina and Guest looming...」

0x00BBA8.en: 「He'll use that to buy time,@　gather evidence, and grease the wheels.」

0x00BC3B.en: 「Thanks to that footage spreading, more of the@　public are coming to believe the Gaia Sabers@　conspiracy theory, that you were framed.」

0x00BE82.en: 「Yes. The Marshal got Alteur to concede it@　in their maneuvering. However, your military@　commissions remain stripped, and...」

0x00C149.en: 「All we can do is expose Alteur's plot,@ then leave it to the law. For now, focus@ on how to avert the crisis facing Earth and yourselves.」

0x00C4F9.en: 「Right. It pains me to exploit your@　position like this, but...」

0x00C558.en: 「If we judge that hard measures are needed@　to expose Alteur's conspiracy,@　you'll be the ones we send in.」

0x00C80B.en: 「No, we'd manage that much. I'll grease the wheels.」

0x00C864.en: 「One more thing - a private firm has offered@ to supply the Steel Dragons with materiel,@ shipped to Itiiti Island in a disguised transport.」

0x00C91F.en: 「Centrum Express...@　The owner is Ensign Aqua Centrum's uncle...」

0x00CAFD.en: 「Also, Senator Centrum made a request...@　He'd prefer Ensign Aqua not be told@　where the supplies come from.」

0x00CBCD.en: 「He doesn't want her to think he's coddling her.」

0x00CC72.en: 「...Not just Vice Admiral Jacob and Ensign Aqua's@　kin, but President Mitsuko Isurugi and Dr. Shu Shirakawa too...」

0x00CD0D.en: 「In the end, you could say they've all@　lent us a helping hand.」

0x00CD69.en: 「Shu Shirakawa aside,@　Mitsuko Isurugi is another matter...」

0x00CDBF.en: 「Along with Dr. Shirakawa's intel, one could say@　she entrusted the Vegalion and Sleigh Presty@　to us as well.」

0x00CE67.en: 「Whatever the other party wanted, Ibis and@　the others did wish for her return.」

0x00D0AB.en: 「Unavoidable for now, but...@　President Mitsuko Isurugi and Dr. Shu Shirakawa too...」

0x00D623.en: （Earth itself...@　could it be the Fabula Foris in Antarctica?）
